C1195.title: Luzhou Cyber Police Crack Down on SMS Bombing Software and Service Providers
C1195.summary: Luzhou cyber police disclosed that officers handling a relationship dispute were targeted with SMS bombing harassment. Investigators found that Wang had purchased a "call-you-to-death" service online and used automated tools supplied by a group led by Xie to send large volumes of messages to designated numbers. Police traced the service across regions and arrested the providers, exposing a pay-per-use SMS bombing supply chain.

references.title: Rampant 'call-you-to-death' harassment? Cyber police pursue across provinces and reveal the hidden chain
